evidence.min_area_px_20260831: 150 -> 80 on 2026-08-31, measured twice as the operator moved the box. The shipped ColourBlobDetector applies a median blur and a 7x7 ellipse opening on top of a sat_min 200 threshold, all of which erode the blob, so the area floor has to sit well under the raw contour. With the box at ~1.65 m the panel measured 40x18 px and needed <=120 (0/25 at 150, 25/25 at 120); after the box was moved to ~1.47 m further out it measured 32x16 px and needed <=80 (0/25 at 100, 25/25 at 80). Only the area floor moved: the panel is operator-taped at 10.0 x 5.0 cm and width_m/height_m are unchanged.
